units.source_text: 夕雾大将来六条院参见，源氏颇思知道他的心事，对他说道：“老夫人七七已经过了吧。

en.t: General Yugiri came to Rokujoin to pay his respects, and Genji, very much wanting to know what was on his mind, said to him, "The old lady's forty-nine days of mourning must already be over, must they not?

units.source_text: 回忆此人以更衣入侍时，至今匆匆已历三十年。

en.t: When I think back to the time when she entered service as a consort, thirty years have already passed in a flash.

units.source_text: 无常迅速，实甚可悲。

en.t: Impermanence comes so swiftly; it is truly sorrowful.

units.source_text: 人生所贪恋的，只是朝露一般的欢乐而已！

en.t: What people cling to in life is nothing more than joy as fleeting as morning dew!

units.source_text: 我很想把这头发剃掉，将世间万事一概抛开。

en.t: I long to shave off this hair and cast aside everything in the world.

units.source_text: 然而至今还是苟且偷安，因循度日，实在很不好呢。”

en.t: Yet even now I keep taking the easy way and passing my days as before; it is truly no good."

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“果然如此。

en.t: Yugiri answered, "That is indeed so.

units.source_text: 即使是表面看来毫无留恋的人，在他本人也确有难于抛舍之苦呢。”

en.t: Even someone who appears from the outside to have no attachments must surely suffer from things that are hard to cast away."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“老夫人四十九日中一切佛事，都由大和守一人办理，实在太凄凉了。

en.t: Then he continued, "All the Buddhist rites during the old lady's forty-nine days were handled by the Governor of Yamato alone; it was terribly lonely.

units.source_text: 没有确实可靠的保护者的人，生前犹可，死后实甚可悲。”

en.t: For someone without a truly dependable protector, life may still be bearable, but after death it is deeply pitiful."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“朱雀院定然遣使吊慰过了。

en.t: Genji said, "Suzaku-in must surely have sent a messenger with condolences.

units.source_text: 他那二公主不知悲伤得怎么样。

en.t: I wonder how deeply his Second Princess is grieving.

units.source_text: 那位更衣，据我近年来便中所见所闻，比以前传闻的好得多，竟是一位无瑕可指的淑女。

en.t: From what I have happened to see and hear in recent years, that consort was far better than the old rumors suggested, and was in fact a flawless lady.

units.source_text: 世人都在悼惜她呢。

en.t: Everyone in the world is mourning and regretting her loss.

units.source_text: 应该活着的人，偏偏短命而死。

en.t: The very person who ought to have lived has instead died young.

units.source_text: 朱雀院也一定大为震惊，不胜悲伤吧。

en.t: Suzaku-in too must be deeply shocked and overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 他对二公主的钟爱，仅次于这里的已出家的三公主。

en.t: His love for the Second Princess is second only to his love for the Third Princess here, who has already taken religious vows.

units.source_text: 想见二公主品貌也是极美妙的吧。”

en.t: I imagine the Second Princess must also be wonderfully beautiful in character and appearance."

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“二公主品貌如何，不得而知。

en.t: Yugiri said, "What the Second Princess is like in character or appearance, I cannot know.

units.source_text: 老夫人的人品与性情，真是无瑕可指的。

en.t: The old lady's character and disposition were truly beyond reproach.

units.source_text: 虽然和我并未亲昵熟悉，但在些些小事上，也可显见此人性情之优越。”

en.t: Although she and I were never especially intimate, even in small matters one could clearly see the excellence of her nature."

units.source_text: 关于二公主，他绝不谈起，装作全不知道。

en.t: As for the Second Princess, he would not speak of her at all and pretended to know nothing.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“他对此事已是专心一志，我若劝谏，徒劳无益。

en.t: Genji thought, "He is already wholly fixed on this matter; even if I admonish him, it will be useless.

units.source_text: 明知他不会听信而向他郑重提出，也太没意思了。”

en.t: To raise it solemnly with him when I know he will not listen would be far too pointless."

units.source_text: 便置之不谈。

en.t: So he left the matter unspoken.
